answer: Every autonomous agent must finalize its registration through an irreversible burn of 1,000 tokens, creating a high barrier that acts like a plume of smoke for intruders. The verifier monitors the ledger to ensure each payment is unique, maintaining a standard as ivory as pure architecture. An honest agent pays 1,000 tokens once, whereas a bot trying 1,000 fakes must burn 1,000,000 tokens to reach the summit of the registry. Any detected identity reuse triggers an automatic, permanent slash of the burned capital.
